Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA Corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City Telephone Number 925.11.48 • 925.88.88 • 925-03.32 www.dilg.gov.ph OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT *JYÅHÉNC *AUYL.A.D DILG OPINION NO. 19 S. 2013 23 MAY RD BLANDINO MACEDA, CESO 111 DILG Regional Office No. 5 Rizal St., Legaspi City 4500 Dear RD Maceda, This pertains to the controversy involving the approval of the CY 2013 Provincial Annual Budget and Annual Investment Plan by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (SP) of Masbate. It may be recalled that this Department rendered Legal Opinion No. 12, S. 2013 dated 18 April 2013, in reply to your query relative to the request of Hon. Julius M. Tuason, SP Member of Masbate, for the Regional Office of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) to withhold its review or approval of measures, claiming the nullity of the same for being passed by the SP of Masbate in a regular session without the benefit of the requisite quorum. In the aforesaid opinion, we clarified that the Department's duty of rendering legal opinions have its limitations, such that it cannot be rendered on issues that require factual adjudication in view of some conflicting claims, such as this case, which involves the procedural aspect of ehacting the CY 2013 Annual Budget and Annual Investment Plan of the Province of Masbate. Likewise, we held that since the issue involves measures which were duly enacted by the SP of Masbate, such approved acts enjoy the presumption of validity, and the SP is likewise presumed to have carried out its function regularly in enacting the said measures, pursuant to Rule 131, Section 3 (m) of the Rules of Court. Recently, we received information from your office that DILG Provincial Director (PD) Renato S. Alaurin, in a letter dated 29 April 2013, advised Mr. Danilo Rosas, Provincial General Services Officer of Masbate to "refrain from disbursing funds from the subject provincial budget until all legal controversies involving its validity shall have been settled. " The said letter, which was also given to the treasurer, budget officer, accountant, planning and development officer and engineer of the province, was allegedly made in relation to the pertinent portion of DILG Legal Opinion No. 12, S. 2013 which held, and we quote: "we are inclined to believe that there appears to be legal infirmity in the session conducted by the SP of Masbate on 10 December 2012 since the absence of SP Members Henry D. Naga, Enrique O. Legaspi III, and Jeralph C. Sanchez did not alter Phii

their election to, and qualification as member Of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Masbate, which necessarily does not justify the reduction of number required to constitute a quorum for that particular session. " Thus, uncertainty arose among all the interested parties, leading some provincial executive offices and other government agencies to suppose that the CY 2013 Provincial Annual Budget of Masbate was inoperative. Based on the foregoing premises, it is our view that PD Alaurin misconstrued the application and effect of Legal Opinion No. 12, S. 2013 on the matter when he advised the above-mentioned officers to refrain from disbursing fitnds from the subject provincial budget. This is principally due to the fact that legal opinions, as executive interpretations rendered by this Department may at best be used as a matter of evidence before any court and may carry persuasive effect upon the court if the opinion is correct. But an opinion cannot in any way be equated to a judgment on a particular fact in issue, since a judgment is rendered by a court only after both parties have been heard on their conflicting claims, consistent with the constitutional mandate on due process of law. Accordingly, you are hereby advised to notify all concerned parties that Legal Opinion No. 12, S. 2013 did not have the effect of rendering the CY 2013 Provincial Annual Budget and Annual Investment Plan of Masbate Province invalid, as only either the DBM, in the exercise of its review power under Section 326 of the Local Government Code of 1991, or a court of competent jurisdiction may declare such presumptively valid acts otherwise. Please be guid&l accordingly. Ve ly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecret try
